meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频镜头加上推拉缩放与镜头运动动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让视频片段有缩放、推拉或镜头运动等动画效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, and camera-move keyframes to video shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're animating zooms, punch-ins, or camera moves inside video shots.

howto.what: 让 Claude 在 HyperFrames 合成里编写可跳转(seek-safe)的关键帧动画:推拉缩放、重构图、Ken Burns 镜头移动、遮罩与裁剪等,并用 lint、check、keyframes 等命令校验画面。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推拉、缩放重构图、Ken Burns 或镜头移动等关键帧,或用 GSAP、CSS 关键帧等方式实现时接管;不用于整体分镜策略、品牌设计、素材搜集。

say.text: 给这个片段加一个从 100% 推到 130% 的平滑缩放关键帧
say.note: 会写入 seek-safe 的缩放动画

say.text: 把这个场景改成 Ken Burns 式的缓慢平移加缩放
say.note: 对包装元素做位移与缩放关键帧

say.text: 跑一下 hyperframes keyframes 检查这段动画并截图验证
say.note: 输出诊断与关键帧快照

howto.what_en: Adds seek-safe keyframe animation to HyperFrames compositions: punch-in/out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns camera moves, masks and crops, via GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js or WAAPI, verified with the hyperframes CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs zoom/reframe, Ken Burns or camera-move keyframes, or uses GSAP, CSS keyframes and similar runtimes. Not for scene strategy, brand design or media sourcing.

say_en.text: Add a smooth punch-in from 100% to 130% on this clip
Turn this scene into a slow Ken Burns pan and zoom
Run hyperframes keyframes on this animation and shoot proof frames
